name: Static Oversized Tee
description: A 300 gsm cotton tee cut wide through the body with dropped shoulders and a thick ribbed collar that keeps its shape. The front carries a hand-drawn TV-static graphic in screen-printed red and cobalt over washed black, with a small SEOM tab at the hem. Loud, boxy and made to sit over cargos or under an open puffer.
details: Oversized boxy fit; size down for a regular cut
Machine wash cold inside out, do not tumble dry

name: Sportswear Max90 Tee
description: Nike's Max90 is a thick, dry-handed cotton tee with a roomy body, dropped shoulders and a slightly longer sleeve. This one comes in University Red with an oversized Swoosh across the chest in white. Sporty and bold, it works on its own with track pants or wide jeans and a fresh pair of sneakers.

name: Halo Baby Tee
description: A cropped baby tee in stretch cotton rib that fits close through the body and stops just above the navel. It comes in a pale lilac with a small chrome-foil halo printed at the chest and contrast binding at the neck and cuffs. Pure early-2000s: wear it with low-rise cargos, a slim belt and retro runners.
details: Slim, cropped fit; body length 17 in on size S
Metallic foil print, wash inside out

name: Schatten Long Tee
description: A long-line tee in heavy, fluid modal-cotton jersey that drapes rather than stands away from the body. It runs past the hip with a curved hem, raw-edge neckline and sleeves that fall to the elbow, all garment-dyed to a soft washed black. Moody and quiet, it layers under a long coat or a leather jacket with silver at the throat.
details: Relaxed, elongated fit; back length 31 in on size M
Garment-dyed; color settles after the first wash
Wash cold with darks, line dry

name: Heavyweight Boxy Tee
description: A clean, logo-free tee in dense Japanese cotton with a short, square body and a sleeve that sits just above the elbow. The neck is a narrow, flat rib and the ecru color is undyed, so the fabric has a soft, slightly natural tone. It looks considered with pleated trousers and loafers, and better after a few washes.
details: 100% cotton jersey from a Japanese mill, 280 gsm
Boxy, cropped fit; take your usual size

name: Deià Linen Tee
description: A loose tee knitted from linen-cotton jersey, so it breathes like a linen shirt but pulls on like a tee. The body is wide and slightly cropped with a soft boat neck and rolled sleeves, garment-dyed a sun-faded sand. It is made for hot afternoons, tucked loosely into linen trousers or worn over a swimsuit on the way to the water.

name: P-6 Logo Responsibili-Tee
description: Patagonia's classic P-6 tee, made from a blend of recycled cotton and recycled polyester that keeps old clothes and bottles out of landfill. It has a regular, easy fit and the mountain-and-sky P-6 logo printed on the chest, here on a faded sage. A trailhead favorite that goes just as well with shorts in town.
details: Screen-printed with PVC- and phthalate-free inks

name: Dri-FIT Miler Running Top
description: A light, quick-drying running tee in sweat-wicking Dri-FIT jersey with mesh panels down the back. It has a standard fit that stays out of the way, a reflective Swoosh for early or late runs and flatlock seams that don't chafe. Bright white with volt accents, it handles everything from intervals to gym days.
details: Machine wash cold, do not iron print

name: 365 Midweight T-Shirt
description: Pangaia's everyday tee in organic cotton jersey, finished with a peppermint-oil treatment that keeps it fresher between washes. It has a relaxed, straight body and comes in a saturated cobalt blue from plant-based dyes. Soft and easy, it goes from a morning stretch or gym warm-up to a weekend coffee without changing.

name: Belmont Pocket Tee
description: A heavy slub-cotton work tee with a reinforced chest pocket, a tubular body and double-needle stitching at every hem. It is garment-dyed a deep tobacco brown that fades unevenly at the seams the more it is worn and washed. Rugged and plain, it is the shirt under a chore coat or double-knees on a workshop Saturday.
details: Regular fit with a slightly long body
Wash warm, tumble dry low; expect 3% shrinkage

name: Bristol Oxford Shirt
description: A button-down oxford shirt in a heavy, slightly slubby American oxford cloth that softens with every wash. It has a full, unlined collar roll, a box pleat and locker loop at the back, and a long tail that stays tucked. Crisp and easy in classic blue, it goes with chinos and a shetland on campus or under a navy blazer at the office.
details: Regular fit with a full chest
Unlined button-down collar with a soft roll
Box pleat, locker loop, mother-of-pearl buttons
Machine wash warm, hang dry, iron while damp
imageQuery: blue oxford button down shirt man

name: Newport Oversized Oxford Shirt
description: Cranmore's oxford cut wide for women: a borrowed-from-him shape with dropped shoulders, a curved tail and a button-down collar that can be worn open. The cloth is a crisp university stripe in pink and white that softens into a lived-in feel. It works tucked into a pleated skirt with loafers or half-tucked into straight jeans with a cable knit over the shoulders.
details: Oversized fit; size down for a closer shape

name: Valldemossa Linen Shirt
description: A loose camp-collar shirt in washed European linen with a straight hem made to be worn out. The weave is light and open, the color a soft sky blue that looks faded by sun and salt, and the shell buttons are left a little loose for air. It belongs on a terrace with drawstring trousers and espadrilles, and travels crumpled without minding.
details: Relaxed fit with a camp collar
Machine wash cold, line dry; wrinkles are part of it
imageQuery: light blue linen shirt man beach

name: Liv Broderie Blouse
description: A soft white blouse in cotton broderie anglaise, with full puff sleeves gathered into narrow cuffs and a scalloped edge at the round neck. The body is loose and falls to the hip, so it floats over jeans or tucks into a gathered skirt. Romantic and a little undone, it is made for summer evenings, picnics and garden weddings.
details: 100% cotton broderie anglaise, lined at the body
Relaxed fit; puff sleeves with elastic cuffs
Covered buttons at the back neck
Hand wash cold or delicate cycle, line dry
Made in small runs in Portugal

name: Tove Gingham Smocked Blouse
description: A cropped blouse in light cotton seersucker gingham with a smocked, stretchy bodice, a square neck and short balloon sleeves that can sit on or off the shoulder. The check is a small rose-and-cream gingham that reads soft and sweet rather than picnic-blanket. Wear it with a long skirt and sandals or with wide trousers for something a little more grown-up.
details: Made in small runs in Portugal

name: Oversized Poplin Shirt
description: A big, boxy shirt in crisp Japanese cotton poplin with a deep yoke, dropped shoulders and long sleeves meant to be pushed up. There is no chest pocket and no visible branding, just a hidden placket and a slightly longer back. In pure white it looks clean with wide pleated trousers and works as a light jacket over a tank in summer.
details: Oversized fit; take your usual size

name: Relaxed Linen Shirt
description: A relaxed shirt in mid-weight washed linen with a classic collar, a single chest pocket and a gently rounded hem. The color is a warm oatmeal that sits easily with white, navy and stripes. Breezy and plain, it gets worn open over a swimsuit on holiday and buttoned up with tailored trousers back in the city.

name: Hawthorne Flannel Shirt
description: A heavy brushed-cotton flannel shirt with two flap pockets, a single-needle yoke and a long tail that works tucked or worn as a light overshirt. The plaid is a muted rust, olive and black that hides sawdust and woodsmoke. It breaks in like a favorite blanket and suits a cabin weekend, a hike or a cold morning at the workbench.
details: Regular fit with room to layer a tee

name: TAKIBI Light Ripstop Shirt
description: A camp shirt cut from Snow Peak's TAKIBI fabric, a flame-resistant cotton and aramid ripstop that shrugs off sparks from the fire. It has a boxy, relaxed shape, two zip chest pockets and roll-tab sleeves, in a dusty olive that sits well with other earth tones. Technical without looking it, it goes from the campsite to the city unchanged.
details: Designed in Niigata, made in Japan

name: Alfama Fisherman Cable Sweater
description: A heavy fisherman sweater hand-finished at the family mill, worked in thick undyed Portuguese wool with honeycomb and rope cables down the front. It has a relaxed body, a rolled crew neck and slightly long sleeves to pull over your hands. In natural cream it looks right with a pleated skirt and loafers, or with jeans and a waxed jacket by the sea.
details: Relaxed fit; take your usual size

name: Graça Crochet Cardigan
description: A cropped cardigan crocheted by hand from soft mercerized cotton in an open flower-square pattern. It closes with five small shell buttons and has a gently puffed sleeve, in a warm cream with a faded rose trim. Romantic and light, it layers over a slip dress or a camisole on summer evenings.

name: Kennebunk Cable Crew
description: A classic cable crewneck in soft Shetland-type lambswool, with a center panel of rope cables flanked by moss stitch. It has a saddle shoulder, a comfortable regular fit and ribbing that holds its shape. In bottle green it pairs with an oxford shirt and corduroy, and it gets better looking as it ages.
details: Hand wash cold or wool cycle, dry flat

name: Sigfred Lambswool Sweater
description: Norse Projects' Sigfred is a brushed lambswool crewneck with a soft, slightly hairy hand and a clean, regular fit. It has ribbed trims, a small tonal label at the hem and nothing else. In heather grey it is the knit that works over a tee, a shirt or under a coat for most of the year.

name: Cashmere Crew-Neck Jumper
description: A light, fine-gauge crewneck in pure Mongolian cashmere with a slightly relaxed body and fully fashioned shoulders. The color is a soft camel that looks warm against ecru, grey and denim. Quiet and comfortable, it sits under a coat in winter and over a shirt collar at the office.

name: Riss Ladder-Knit Sweater
description: A long, heavy sweater in mohair and wool, knitted with deliberate dropped stitches so it falls in ladders and gaps down the body and sleeves. It is dyed pure black and sits long over the hips with sleeves that run past the wrist. Moody and textured, it is meant to be layered over a slip dress or a long tee with heavy boots and silver.
details: Oversized, longline fit; back length 30 in on size S

name: Pollença Knitted Polo
description: A short-sleeved polo knitted from a cool, dry linen and cotton yarn in a fine, open stitch. It has a soft open collar with no buttons, ribbed trims and a straight hem for wearing loose, in a creamy white with a thin navy tipping. It is made for long lunches by the sea with linen trousers and suede loafers.
details: Hand wash or wool cycle cold, dry flat

name: Recycled Wool-Blend Crewneck Sweater
description: A rugged crewneck knitted from recycled wool and nylon in a mid-gauge stitch with a marled, earthy look. The fit is easy and roomy enough for a base layer underneath, and the color is a warm mixed brown with flecks of rust. Warm on a cold trail morning and easy to wear in town with canvas pants and boots.

name: Flicker Cropped Cardigan
description: A short, fitted cardigan in a fluffy brushed-acrylic and nylon yarn with a slight sheen. It fastens with five chrome-look buttons and comes in baby blue with a thin contrast white edge. Very early 2000s, it looks right buttoned up as a top with a low-rise skirt or worn open over a baby tee.
details: Slim, cropped fit; body length 16 in on size S

name: Sportswear Phoenix Fleece Oversized Hoodie
description: Nike's Phoenix Fleece is a thick, brushed-back cotton blend that feels soft inside and holds its shape outside. This hoodie is cut extra roomy with dropped shoulders, a deep hood and a stacked hem, in black with a small embroidered Swoosh. Sporty and slouchy, it goes over leggings after the gym or with baggy jeans and sneakers.
details: Oversized fit; size down for a closer cut

name: Adicolor Classics Firebird Track Top
description: The Firebird is Adidas' archive track top in shiny tricot, with the 3-Stripes running down each sleeve and a stand-up collar. It has a slim, slightly cropped fit and comes in pale blue with white stripes. Sporty and retro, it zips up over a baby tee with low-rise track pants or jeans and Sambas.
details: Full zip, ribbed cuffs and hem
imageQuery: adidas firebird track jacket blue woman

name: Athletics French Terry Crewneck
description: A loopback French terry crewneck with the NB Athletics varsity arch printed across the chest. It has a relaxed fit, ribbed side panels and a soft, worn-in hand, in heather grey with a navy print. Half gym kit, half campus classic, it goes with running shorts or chinos and grey suede sneakers.
details: Machine wash cold, tumble dry low

name: 365 Midweight Hoodie
description: Pangaia's 365 hoodie is a midweight organic cotton fleece with a recycled cotton blend, a deep two-panel hood and a kangaroo pocket, cut relaxed through the body. It comes in a saturated summit green from plant-based dyes, with a small tonal print on the chest. Built for lounging and slow mornings, it is just as good on the walk to yoga or a recovery run.
details: Organic and recycled cotton fleece, 450 gsm

name: Signal Boxy Hoodie
description: A heavyweight 500 gsm fleece hoodie with a short, wide body, an oversized double hood and a cracked puff-print graphic across the back. It is pigment-dyed a washed black that fades unevenly at the seams and cuffs, so it looks dark and worn-in from day one. Loud from behind and moody from the front, it sits over cargos or under a long black coat.
details: Boxy, cropped fit; size up for more length
Wash cold inside out, line dry

name: Hooded Chase Sweatshirt
description: Carhartt WIP's Chase hoodie is a dense cotton-polyester fleece with a two-panel hood, a kangaroo pocket and a small gold C logo embroidered at the chest. The fit is regular and straight, and the dark brown color goes with canvas, denim and duck. Plain and hard-wearing, it lives under a Detroit jacket or on its own with double-knees.

name: Mystic Rugby Shirt
description: A heavyweight rugby shirt knitted from tightly twisted cotton jersey, with bold navy and gold hoops, a white twill collar and rubber buttons at the placket. It has a regular, slightly long fit and reinforced side vents, so it handles a muddy Saturday or a weekend in the country. Wear it with chinos and loafers or with straight jeans and beat-up sneakers.
details: Machine wash cold, tumble dry low
